incident: Kubernetes pod crash from invalid liveness probe
symptoms: application health endpoint returned 200 when called manually
Kubernetes events showed failed liveness probes
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: The deployment used the wrong liveness probe path after a route rename.
successful_steps: Compared probe path with application routes
resolution: Kubernetes restarted healthy notification pods because the liveness probe targeted a removed route. Correcting the probe fixed the restarts.
postmortem: Resource changes did not affect the probe failure.
More replicas would have multiplied unnecessary restarts.
